_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-22. CardID = 17600 + idx; 361 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 61). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card. His deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the turtles' and the other heroes': only deck.identity (data/tts/loki.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).
Hero card (read from the image): LOKI, MELEE, START HEALTH 16, MOVE 2, MISCHIEF-MONGER. NO sidekick: unmatched-memory has an empty sidekick entry (a slip), the overlay says sidekicks [].

Slip fixed from the image: Shapeshifter prints BOOST 2 (unmatched-memory has 3). Titles in Title Case; the unmatched-memory spellings are in `memory_title` (Shapershifter, the TRICK: prefix, Svadilfari). The four TRICK cards (Baldr's Downfall, Freyja's Rescue, Sindri's Bet, Svadilfari's Lure) carry the band ANY (Ivan 2026-11-22, LO2: any fighter of the opponent may play one) and the tag `trick`, have no BOOST (0: they cannot boost) and print two parts, LOKI and NOT LOKI; their `text` writes both. Svadilfari's Lure is a scheme with no printed value (null).
